kypExtensions.summary: The interpreter-visit grammar: STATION 0 identify the language by ASKING (never assuming from name, skin tone, or accent) → STATION 1 the fallback ladder (professionally trained medical interpreter in person — unless the physician is conversationally fluent — → telephone or video call → family member if the patient prefers, recorded in the chart) → STATION 2 the conduct rules (eye contact, direct second-person speech with no third-person 'tell him,' extra time, one question at a time) → STATION 3 the positioning mirror (spoken: interpreter next to or slightly behind the PATIENT; sign: next to or slightly behind the PHYSICIAN) → STATION 4 the emergency override (any tools available — friends, family, sketches, interpreter apps — even though not standard procedure otherwise) → the yield: a visit that stays doctor-patient. The station organization, the ladder framing, the two-person-conversation reading, and the sightline logic behind the positioning mirror are KYP's synthesis; every rule and position is printed.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints six parallel paragraphs of rules; the staged-protocol organization (stations 0-4), the fallback-ladder framing, the conduct grammar, and the sightline reasoning (why the sign interpreter sits at the physician's side) are KYP's design — the print gives the positions without the why.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] interpreter-visit-flow + blocks[3] the decoder list + blocks[4] the steps block + blocks[5] the compare block (the positioning mirror) + the registry visual's Zone A

kypExtensions.summary: The order reading of First Aid's own SPIKES acronym: stage before speech (Setting), calibrate before content (Perception), permission before disclosure (Invitation), chunk before check (Knowledge — with its own comprehension check), clear the emotion before the plan (Emotions), and return control (Strategy — gated on the patient feeling ready, closing with the print's own control-return questions). The unskippable-order claim and the failure-mode mapping (hallway disclosure = skipped Setting; ambushing = skipped Invitation; planning over tears = skipped Emotions) are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.rationale: SPIKES and every station move are the source's own (attributed, not counted as KYP's); the ordering logic — WHY the stations cannot swap — is nowhere printed; the KYP reading is the note's and the visual's order strip.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + mechanisms[1] spikes-flow + blocks[1] the SPIKES table block caption + the registry visual's Zone B order strip + usmle.traps[3]
